thesis: Morgan Housel argues that venture capital and public markets are fundamentally the same activity, differing only in how investors weight the elements of change versus stability, and that the overlap between them is far larger than expected. Jason Zweig adds skepticism to the idea that returns differ significantly across early-stage, public, and buyout markets when returns are adjusted for leverage and risk.
